ValidationRule.description: Restricts Accounts from having more than 1 Open Opportunity at a given time.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
Account.Open_Opportunities__c > 1 && RecordTypeId <> "012Vb000007jxvxIAA" && RecordType.Name <> "Foundation Opportunity" && (Text(StageName)!="Closed Lost")
&& Opportunity_Type__c ="New Sale" && $Profile.Name != "System Administrator" && $User.Email != "brittani@teamvelocitymarketing.com"
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Account already has an Open Opportunity. You may not have more than 1 Open Opportunity for an Account at a given time.
